flows.title: Ask Grok a question
steps: Go to grok.com. The prompt box is on the page itself, so there is no separate step to reach it.
Type the question into the box, whose placeholder reads Ask Grok anything.
Attach, beside the box, adds a file to the question before it is sent.
The control labelled Fast, also beside the box, selects the answering mode.
Select Submit to send the question. Imagine and Settings sit in the side navigation, and Sign in and Sign up in the corner.
